originality.rationale: The inspected Numata--Takahashi--Tamaki 2022 paper provides general quiver facet criteria without the special transitive-tournament edge formula or simple-vertex cutoff. Setiabrata 2020 characterizes origin-adjoined positive-root faces, which cover just the edges retained upon adjoining zero; the n-2 unit-chain edges are absent there. The explicit complete nonorigin edge criterion and degree/simplicity classification are not stated in the checked literature. Named unresolved full-text risk is retained; search nonmatch alone is not the conclusion.

value.rationale: Determines the entire 1-skeleton and all local degrees for a canonical all-dimensional root-polytope family. Exactly n-2 edges created by deleting the origin quantifies a geometric graph change, and the sharp simple-vertex exhaustion n=3,4,5,>=6 describes real combinatorial phase behavior. These are natural full-family invariants, not a parameter slice, renamed fact, or known-table recomputation.
